required_checks.evidence: Independent static-scene tracks or capture calibration with held validation, coverage and uncertainty.
Source-verified shared physical points across views, including face and clothing; detector labels alone are insufficient.

actual009_read_only_readiness.reason: Coarse body/SfM fitting residuals do not establish the three independent alignment conditions. This development release has no validator that can admit formal Gaussian training.
actual009_read_only_readiness.next_action: Use bounded preprocessing/fit diagnostics. Implement and validate the independent alignment conditions before enabling formal training. No manual approval flag is supported.
actual009_read_only_readiness.scope: Artifact identity and missing-validation report only; not a new camera experiment, physical calibration result or training-quality verdict.
